scripts.build: npm run workspace:assert && npm run build:aliases && npm run build:svgs && npm run build:ui && npm run build:widget
scripts.build:ui: npm run build:version && vite build && node scripts/normalize-ui-bundle.mjs
scripts.watch: npm run build:version && npm run build:aliases && npm run build:svgs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "node scripts/write-app-version.mjs --watch" "vite build --watch" "node scripts/normalize-ui-bundle.mjs --watch" "node esbuild.config.mjs --watch"
scripts.debug:restart: npm run debug:stop && npm run debug:session
scripts.debug:build: PLUGIN_DEBUG=1 PLUGIN_DEBUG_LOG_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4789/log npm run build && npm run debug:manifests
scripts.debug:watch: npm run debug:manifests && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "PLUGIN_DEBUG=1 PLUGIN_DEBUG_LOG_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4789/log npm run watch" "node scripts/write-debug-manifests.mjs --watch"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:plugin && npm run typecheck:ui
scripts.release:build: npm run release:guard && npm run build && npm run release:assert
scripts.release:check: npm run release:guard && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run release:assert && git diff --check
